name: @polymech/pm-vfs
description: Standalone VFS jail and pm-vfs CLI. HTTP is the serve command; ACL is a separate package.

scripts.build:cpp: npm run configure && node ../../scripts/cmake.mjs --build --preset dev --target pm-vfs
scripts.build:cpp:release: npm run configure:release && node ../../scripts/cmake.mjs --build --preset release --target pm-vfs
